Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

weekend — Saturday and Sunday. Example: On Saturday I am meeting my friends.
friend — a person you like and know well. Example: I am meeting my friends.
go — to move to another place. Example: Last weekend I went to the cinema.
see — to look at something. Example: We saw a good film.
buy — to get something with money. Example: I bought a book.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I went to ...
• I saw ...
• I bought ...
• Did you go out?
• It was great.

Grammar focus: Past Simple (regular & irregular verbs).
Use irregular past forms: go becomes went, see becomes saw, buy becomes bought. Ask Did you ...? with the base verb.
